params.name: address
params.description: The **full address** of the property, in the format `Street, City, State, Zip`. You need to provide either the `address` or the `latitude`/`longitude` parameters

params.name: latitude
params.description: The latitude of the property. The `latitude`/`longitude` can be provided instead of the `address` parameter

params.name: longitude
params.description: The longitude of the property. The `latitude`/`longitude` can be provided instead of the `address` parameter

params.name: propertyType
params.description: The type of the property. See [explanation of property types](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/property-types)

params.name: bedrooms
params.description: The number of bedrooms in the property. Use `0` to indicate a studio layout

params.name: bathrooms
params.description: The number of bathrooms in the property. Supports fractions to indicate partial bathrooms

params.name: squareFootage
params.description: The total living area size of the property, in square feet

params.name: maxRadius
params.description: The maximum distance between comparable listings and the subject property, in miles

params.name: daysOld
params.description: The maximum number of days since comparable listings were last seen on the market, with a minimum of 1

params.name: compCount
params.description: The number of comparable listings to use when calculating the value estimate, between 5 and 25. Defaults to `15` if not provided

params.name: lookupSubjectAttributes
params.description: When enabled, will attempt to look up subject property attributes to find more relevant comps. Defaults to `true` if not provided. [Learn more](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/property-valuation#subject-property-attribute-lookup) about this feature

items.docs: Returns a property value estimate and comparable properties.
